metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the commination, the old year at the head of the book, and the cold stage.

yesterday: The commination was read, and Master Thwaite enjoyed it. Evening prayer was the office.
The account book says 1594. The Queen's twenty pounds is still not had.
The company is idle. Kemp has said three pounds. Ralph Raye had seen the flag. You said a fortnight, and you stayed on this side of the river. Supper was fish, threepence.
Tomorrow is Paul's in the morning, if the book you want is there. The fast is begun. The house is fish.
